item.title: The SEC is distributing more than $1B to its schools for the 2024-25 fiscal year
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (AP) — The Southeastern Conference is distributing more than $1 billion to its 16 universities for the 2024-25 fiscal year, which ended last August. The total distribution jumped more than $200 million from the previous year. item.title: Pizza Hut closing 250 US stores as parent company considers selling the brand
item.description: By DEE-ANN DURBIN Pizza Hut plans to close 250 U.S. restaurants in the first half of this year as its parent company considers a sale of the chain. Yum Brands said Wednesday it’s targeting underperforming Pizza Hut restaurants in its system. item.title: Two pedestrians struck and killed on I-10 near exit 41
item.description: BILOXI, Miss. (WXXV)- Two pedestrians were struck and killed on I-10 westbound near exit 41 on Thursday night. According to the Biloxi Police Department, the accident involved two vehicles, and it happened just before 7pm. As a result of the crash, the left two lanes of I-10 westbound are closed. item.title: US job openings fall to 6.5 million, fewest since 2020, as labor market remains sluggish
item.description: By PAUL WISEMAN WASHINGTON (AP) — U.S. job openings fell to the lowest level in more than five years, another sign that the American labor market remains sluggish. The Labor Department reported Thursday that vacancies fell to 6.5 million in December — from 6.9 million in November and the fewest since September 2020. Layoffs rose slightly. item.description: By STAN CHOE NEW YORK (AP) — Sharp drops hit Wall Street on Thursday as technology stocks fell and bitcoin plunged again to roughly half its record price set last fall.
